name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.live.SpeechVoiceLiveVideoV2Activity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the live-video reward experience. It plays the promoted live video and tracks when the viewing requirement is met.
disableEffect: The live-video ad task will stop, and its viewing rewards will no longer be granted.
